ownerRequest: give yourself a slash goal and start work on it, you can work as long as you need. I want the workable product with couple of movie demos you made with it. Serious good cinematic qualities.
objective: A usable local personal film studio plus two distinct finished cinematic short films produced through the same reusable product workflow.

supersession.rc6: PAUSED_UNCHANGED; C29 remains physical FAIL, attempt118 remains interrupted without verdict. Future RC6 continuation still requires the exact C1 attempt119 adapter.
supersession.scope: New non-liquid product and film work is authorized by the current owner request. Historical no-render constraints remain attached to RC6 and its retained inputs; they are not changed into permission to render failed liquid.

delivery.surface: Native Blender personal-studio controls with a local launcher, versioned projects, shot selection, bounded director revisions, preview, render resume, save/reopen and clear usage instructions.
delivery.runtime: Exact existing RC5 binary plus explicitly loaded new Python product modules; no claim that a new native binary was built.
demos: Nocturnal reel-to-reel machine microfilm: detailed manufactured subject, authored mechanical motion, warm practical/cool night lighting, sound and four-shot editorial progression.
Daylight kinetic sculpture microfilm: solver-owned rigid-body response, distinct architecture/materials and measured event-led cinematography, sound and four-shot progression.
delivery.target: Two 16-24 second movies, 24 fps, 1920-wide scope composition, editable blend files and project specifications. Final resolution/samples frozen after measured calibration, before formal renders.

developmentAdmission.policy: Every candidate uses a unique subroot and records code/spec hashes, argv, process status, rendered frames, semantic result and visual judgment. No overwriting failed candidate evidence. Stop before any ceiling; a versioned bounded continuation is required.

gates.question: Can both projects use one validated product schema/compiler with no demo-ID branching?
Can a user revise one shot, change editorial timing/look, undo and save/reopen without damaging protected state?
checks: failed jobs retained and completed frames not duplicated

gates.question: Do fresh frames and motion justify final movie production?
checks: appropriate focus and native motion blur
distinct shots and coherent screen direction
no obvious intersection or unsupported geometry
all bounded physical contact frames directly reviewed

gates.question: Are two complete, usable films and editable products delivered?
checks: same frozen compiler for both final projects
local launch path and documented user actions verified

formalPolicy: Freeze formal project/compiler identities, exact output profile, frame counts, visual questions and per-film resource ceilings in a later contract before final production. Development render quality is not final acceptance.
visualAuthority: Assistant evaluates fresh frames/playback as requested. Owner approval remains owner-authored and is never fabricated. Cinematic quality is a documented judgment, not proven by numeric checks alone.
assetPolicy: Initially local procedural assets and original local sound synthesis. Any later download needs public provenance, license, size and identity recorded before use; no purchase or new billable service.
regressionPolicy: RC5 binary and historical modules remain unchanged. New modules use a separate namespace and isolated configuration. Preserve frozen RC4/D1/H1/RC5 records and perform proportionate integration checks before product publication.
